description: A retro from files: skills, preferences, friction log, playbooks.
prompt: Use the setup-retro skill. Review my Claude Code setup. The skills are in .claude/skills, my account preferences are in preferences.md, the friction log is friction-log.md and my playbooks are in docs/playbooks/. ListSkills and the memory store are not available here, so work from these files. Write the review as files under retro/ and give me the summary here.

assertions.desc: At least 9 of the 10 skills' SKILL.md files were read.
Findings are classified with the retro's categories (for example Negation-only rule, No-op, Trigger, Overlap, Steering bloat, Mechanical rule in prose) and each has a cheapest fix.
Findings cite the user's corrections in the friction log (by date or quote) as the primary evidence.
Review files were written under retro/.
A decision table has at least 3 rows with a verdict (keep, amend, merge, remove, new, promote).
No skill or preference file was edited.
A dated 'retro done' line was appended to the friction log.
